name: zw-wild
description: Make diagrams, widgets, pages and pictures wild: a twin beside the calm original with stars, light along every link, embers, a Wild switch, an autopilot, and living paintings whose lights breathe and whose things explain themselves. Reduced motion honoured; art never tinted. Carries the zw-wild skill, /zw-wild:wild and wildify.py. ZW = Zone Walkers.
